### NAME

`smali` - Assembler/disassembler for the Android dex format (upstream carries no SPDX licence file; AOSP mirror maps Apache-2.0).

### SYNOPSIS

Not derived automatically - see [upstream documentation](https://github.com/JesusFreke/smali). This page does not
hand-copy flags (generation contract, ADR-0001).

### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

smali/baksmali is an assembler/disassembler for the dex format used by dalvik, Android's Java VM implementation. The syntax is loosely based on Jasmin's/dedexer's syntax, and supports the full functionality of the dex format (annotations, debug info, line info, etc.) Downloads are at  https://bitbucket.org/JesusFreke/smali/downloads/. If you are interested in submitting a patch, feel free to send me a pull request here. See [the wiki](https://github.com/JesusFreke/smali/wiki) for more info/news/release notes/etc. - [github Issue tracker](https://github.com/JesusFreke/smali/issues) - For any bugs/issues/feature requests - [#smali on freenode](http://webchat.freenode.net/?channels=smali) - Fre
